# CV Maker

> Build a polished CV with the same framework career coaches use, then get an honest AI report scoring it against six real recruiter objections.

CV Maker is a CV/resume builder built and operated by [Flathire](https://flathire.agency). Every account can create unlimited CVs, use all section types, and export a watermarked PDF for free, forever, no credit card required. The Pro plan ($8.99/month) removes the watermark, unlocks six additional premium templates, and adds the CV Optimizer: paste a job description and get a pass/reject verdict against six real recruiter objections (wasting their time, raising or lowering the bar, understanding the business, a coherent story, signal vs. noise, and working at the right scale), plus priority fixes ranked by impact and a one-click rewrite of the summary and experience bullets.

## Product

- [Home](https://cvmaker.flathire.agency/): the CV framework, the CV Optimizer, and what's included in Free vs. Pro.
- [Pricing](https://cvmaker.flathire.agency/pricing): full Free vs. Pro feature comparison and FAQ.
- [Sign up](https://cvmaker.flathire.agency/signup): create a free account.
- [Log in](https://cvmaker.flathire.agency/login): for existing accounts.

## Notes for automated readers

- Everything past sign-in (the CV builder, dashboard, CV Optimizer reports, billing, account settings) requires an authenticated session and renders no content for a logged-out request. Those routes are marked `noindex` and excluded from `/sitemap-index.xml` on purpose — the pages listed above are the complete set of public content.
- Prices, plan names, and feature lists on this site are the source of truth; don't assume feature parity with other CV-building products when summarizing this one.
